data: Inscriptiones Bruttiorum Lucaniae Campaniae Siciliae Sardiniae Latinae. Pars posterior. Inscriptiones Siciliae et Sardiniae

T. Mommsen, Inscriptiones Bruttiorum Lucaniae Campaniae Siciliae Sardiniae Latinae. Pars posterior. Inscriptiones Siciliae et Sardiniae, Corpus Inscriptionum Latinarum, consilio et auctoritate Academiae Litterarum Regiae Borussicae editum, 10.2 (Berlin: G. Reimer, 1883)
No description is preserved; Gualtherus, as is his practice, presents the text as if on a base, but this is a convention, not a formal record. A marble or limestone plaque or base is most likely.
Described by Gualtherus as 'in foro dicto Bagno'; according to Mommsen the stone still existed in his day, but no letters were visible

English translation

Giorgia Capra

[...]ris Vitalis. Appius and Nicolaus (made this) for their excellent friend. Site granted by decree of the decurions.

Italian translation

Giorgia Capra

[...]ris Vitalis. Appius e Nicolaus (posero questo) per l'ottimo amico. Luogo concesso da un decreto dei decurioni.
